widgets_values: Reference sheet: Top Row Left (Character): a portrait photo of a young woman with shoulder-length dark hair streaked pink and blue, large gold hoop earrings, a small leaf tattoo on her neck and a beige knitted sweater. Top Row Right (Prop): a chunky, boxy bright-yellow camera with a round lens and a textured grille on its side. Bottom Row Left (Setting): an empty rooftop terrace with a brick parapet, potted olive trees, string lights and a city skyline. Generated video: On the rooftop terrace at golden hour, the young woman with pink-and-blue streaked hair and gold hoop earrings, wearing the beige knitted sweater, faces the lens holding the chunky bright-yellow camera up to her right eye with both hands. She presses the shutter, then slowly lowers the camera to her chest with both hands still on it, and looks straight into the lens with a small smile as a breeze lifts her streaked hair. Static medium shot from the waist up, the brick parapet and olive trees behind her. The sound is the click of the shutter, a light breeze and distant traffic.

nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
## Use your own sheet

Load a reference sheet in **Reference sheet**, then describe the shot in **Prompt**, naming what is on the sheet. **Shorter side** sets the size, keeping the sheet's shape; **Seconds** and **Frame rate** set the length.

**Needs** ComfyUI 0.37 or newer (frontend 1.53 or newer) and ComfyUI-LTXVideo at commit 3bf3ca6 or newer. If any node shows up red, here or inside a subgraph, update ComfyUI or the LTXVideo pack rather than rewiring the graph.
